title: Greek Feta Casserole
description: A classic Greek-inspired casserole with a tangy feta cheese flavor. Perfect as a side dish or light lunch.
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the tomato sauce and stir to combine.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and stir to combine with the tomato sauce.
In a separate bowl, crumble the feta cheese.
In a greased 9x13-inch casserole dish, arrange half of the pasta mixture in the bottom of the dish.
Top the pasta with the crumbled feta cheese, followed by the remaining pasta mixture.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
